## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{python}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{python}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

## Meet the penguins

The `penguins` data from the [https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/](palmerpenguins package) contains size measurements for 344 penguins from three species observed on three islands in the Palmer Archipelago, Antarctica.

![](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/reference/figures/lter_penguins.png)

Apparently, @horstPalmerArchipelagoPenguins2022 wrote something about penguins.
I also found an article about hypothermia in penguins [@handrichHypothermiaForagingKing1997], which I would never have thought of.
